page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance utilizes Intel Xeon 6462C processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated CPU allocation for workloads requiring consistent compute performance.

This instance type does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, which supports high-throughput data transfers between instances and external storage systems. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration, which represents a tradeoff for workloads requiring hardware-accelerated graphics or direct public internet routing without external gateway configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr8i.16xlarge provides a high density of memory relative to its compute resources, offering 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This resource ratio is designed for memory-intensive applications that do not require local disk storage or GPU acceleration. Appropriate workloads for this instance type include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, heavy caching layers, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
